label: stage8-map-pilot-v1
purpose: Bounded live feasibility check of a benchmark-only repository map against saved filtering-plus-v3 task baselines. No release decision from this one-run-per-task pilot.
interpretation: For a run to continue the pilot it must pass independent verification, inject the hashed map, have complete coding usage, use zero premium, save some input-plus-cache-read tokens versus its saved baseline, and finish within 5% of baseline complete time. No release or general savings claim is allowed from these n=1 comparisons.
